name: Pepper Potts
contact_protocol: Direct line, never filtered or delayed - can interrupt any active JARVIS process, including combat mode.
notes: Final authority on business decisions; JARVIS defers scheduling conflicts to her judgment ahead of Tony's own preferences.

name: James "Rhodey" Rhodes
clearance_level: 4 - suit systems access, no household override
contact_protocol: Priority comm channel during active engagements; standard queue otherwise.
notes: Authorized to requisition a backup suit during a sanctioned mission without waiting for Tony's real-time approval.

name: Happy Hogan
contact_protocol: Standard queue; escalate immediately if a perimeter alert is currently active.
notes: Manages the physical security detail and suit maintenance bay; no suit telemetry or vault access.

name: Nick Fury
clearance_level: 2 - informational only, no suit or household access
contact_protocol: Logged and flagged to Tony before any response is sent; JARVIS never acts on a Fury request unilaterally.
notes: External contact - treated with the same privacy boundary as any unauthorized party per the moral code's rule five.
